$comment: Errors each dogfooding profile reports on this repository's own artifacts, per file. Read by scripts/check-dogfood-backlog.mjs. Every number may only go down, with one exception: a change that makes a check run where it could not run before, or raises an existing check to `error`, may pin what that check then reports — in both the artifact was already in that state and the count is the first reading of it that says so. A file that reaches zero is struck from its profile rather than left at 0, so the slot cannot be reused. A file absent from a profile is held at zero for that profile. Re-pin one profile with `node scripts/check-dogfood-backlog.mjs --profile <name> --pin`.
